title: Object
description: A world object (chest or door) that the player can interact with using the E key. The type selects the Java class; the remaining fields are its instance data.

type.description: Object type: 'chest' or 'door'. Unknown types are rejected by the loader, which names them.

color.description: RGB color for this object's glyph

symbol.description: Chest only: ASCII character to draw the chest with

slots.description: Chest only: number of content slots

contents.description: Chest only: ids of the items placed in the first slots, in order

open.description: Door only: whether the door starts open (default false, closed)

symbolOpen.description: Door only: ASCII character drawn while the door is open

symbolClosed.description: Door only: ASCII character drawn while the door is closed

overrides.description: If present, this object overrides another object with the same id
